# Vendored Lua libraries

- `anim8.lua` — `kikito/anim8`, version 2.3.1, MIT (license is included in the source header).
- `hump/camera.lua` — `vrld/hump` camera module, MIT (license is included in the source header).

These small, pure-Lua modules are checked into the project so `love .` works without a separate dependency-install step.
